newsitem.title: THAILAND: Fin One, Thai Danu say to merge.
newsitem.headline: Fin One, Thai Danu say to merge.

text.p: Finance One Plc and Thai Danu Bank Plc confirmed on Monday that they agreed on a friendly merger after careful consideration and the move would be in line with a government policy to strengthen the finance sector.
A joint statement by the two firms said they believed the merger would help boost the overall Thai financial system and benefit clients, staff and shareholders of the two companies.
The statement, filed to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, said the merged company will carry the name of Thai Danu Bank Plc.
It said the two firms expect the Bank of Thailand to approve and back the decision soon.
The Thai bourse on Monday halted trading on all bank and finance stocks to allow clarification on the merger by the two firms and the authorities.
